title: Embedding + Rerank: Auditable PII Mitigation and Retention Controls for Access Logs
creator: Anika Mehta
description:
Background: Embeddings and rerank endpoints currently emit access logs and debugging traces that include raw request/response payloads. For regulated customers and general security posture, we must provide configurable controls that reduce PII exposure risk while keeping the logs sufficiently informative for debugging and audits.

Goal: Deliver a set of controls and implementation that: (1) enables per-tenant retention windows for embedding/rerank logs, (2) supports automatic masking/redaction of PII fields and configurable scrubbers, (3) produces immutable audit events for access and redaction decisions, and (4) preserves operational observability (latency/error metrics) with <5ms median added latency on critical paths.

Acceptance criteria:
- Configurable retention TTL per customer with enforcement at storage layer and a scheduled purge job.
- Redaction pipeline supports regex & NLP-based detectors with opt-in/opt-out per-customer policies.
- Audit events emitted for every redaction decision and for privileged log access; events are write-once and retained separately from raw logs.
- Encryption-at-rest using customer KMS keys for both logs and audit events for Private and Dedicated customers.
- Feature-flagged rollout with canary to 5% of traffic and metrics dashboards: pii_exposure_rate, redaction_false_positive_rate, log_ingest_latency_p50/p95.
- Dev and e2e tests + performance benchmark showing <=5ms median added latency for embedding and rerank inference path in our staging harness.

Non-goals: Full PII detection coverage across every possible customer schema in first phase; enterprise data residency exports (future phase).

2026-03-01 - Luis G: Spike completed. Implemented a prototype redaction step using a hybrid approach: deterministic scrubbers (emails, credit-cards, ips) + lightweight NER model for names/phones. Prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4221

2026-03-04 - Security (Marta Li): Requested audit event schema and suggested storing audit events in an immutable append-only store (S3 with write-once policy backed by Dynamo-style index). Also required KMS envelope encryption for Private customers. See design note: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Embed+Rerank+PII+Audit+Design

2026-03-06 - Luis G: Performance note - prototype added ~3.4ms median to end-to-end path under 64-token workloads. Still need to verify p95. Running batch tests for higher QPS. Added feature flag: feature.flags.redaction_v2

2026-03-09 - Eng lead (Raj Patel): Decided on per-tenant policy model. Policy fields: retention_days, redaction_mode (none|deterministic|hybrid), sample_rate_for_debug_logs (0-1), audit_level (none|access_only|full). Will surface in Console in later iteration. Documented schema in ticket comments.

2026-03-11 - QA (Sofia Tran): Integration test plan added. Tests include: (a) retention purge job validation, (b) redaction correctness tests with fuzzed inputs, (c) audit event correlation test (entry -> redaction event -> access event).

2026-03-12 - Luis G: Deployed canary to 5% of staging traffic. Observed increased redaction_false_positive_rate on a long-tail customer dataset (0.8%). Temporarily tuned NER threshold and added a denylist to reduce FP. Created follow-up sub-issue ENG-32784 for tuning model/eval prompts.

2026-03-14 - Anika M: Preparing PRD for Console controls and admin audit UI. Need PM review on default retention policy for self-serve customers (recommended 30 days) vs enterprise (customer-managed).
Planned artifacts: Design doc (Confluence), prototype PR (runtime/pull/4221), e2e benchmark results (internal dashboard link), Console wireframes (drive link).
notes: Implementation will be staged: phase 1 (deterministic scrubbers + audit events + retention enforcement), phase 2 (hybrid NER tuning + Console controls + per-tenant KMS), phase 3 (fine-grained RBAC and exportable audit reports). Rollout requires security review and legal sign-off for retained event formats.
